shots.title: Start of the level
shots.shows: The fox stands at the left edge at dusk. A low sun behind layered purple hills, dark pine trees along the ground, an arc of five gold coins ahead, three heart icons top-left and a coin counter (x12) top-right.

shots.title: Running toward the coins
shots.shows: The fox a little further right, running toward the arc of five coins. Same dusk sky, sun, layered hills, pine trees, hearts and coin counter as the start.

shots.title: Reaching the coins
shots.shows: The fox under the arc of five coins, about to collect them. Same dusk sky, sun, layered hills, pine trees, hearts and coin counter.
